documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported strong financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27, with significant growth in total income, EBITDA, and PAT. Management highlighted robust domestic and export demand, particularly from the US and emerging opportunities in Europe, while noting active steps in automation and process improvements to counter rising raw material costs. The company expressed confidence in sustaining a growth rate of over 30% for the current financial year and achieving higher profitability and efficiency. Menon Bearings reported a strong financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, with consolidated revenue from operations rising 58.6% year-on-year to Rs. 100.9 crore in Q2 FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects more than 30% growth for FY27 and expects a similar growth rate for the 27-28 period if conditions remain favorable.
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

guidance.claim: Management targets an EBITDA margin of about 23% for the next year.
guidance.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: For the Alkop business, management targets INR100 crores for this year and around INR125 crores for next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects export share to potentially go up to 37% of total revenue by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

guidance.claim: Management reiterates that INR360 crores is a conservative revenue figure for the year.
guidance.quote: So, INR360 crores, I would say is a conservative figure and we will stick to that.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth drivers are primarily domestic demand and rapidly growing US exports.
demand_outlook.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

demand_outlook.claim: A recent Europe tour has yielded significant business potential with more than INR 35 crores to be converted into actual sales in FY27-28 and FY28-29.
demand_outlook.quote: Along with that, our recently Europe tour is yielding a significant increase in the business and potential of more than INR 35 crores that will be converted into the actual sale in the year '27-'28 and '28-'29.

demand_outlook.claim: For FY26-27, additional business expected from the current business pipeline and RFQs is around INR 30 crores on a consolidated basis.
demand_outlook.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

demand_outlook.claim: For FY27-28, estimated additional business is expected to be INR 131 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: And for '27-'28, we expect that estimated additional business will be of INR 131 crores, so that, the growth rate will be obviously more than 30%, with '28-'29, the growth driver, we are having the list of all customers also from whom we are estimated to get the business, RFQs are there, and discussions are going on, commercials have been finalized.

demand_outlook.claim: For 2029, additional business of INR 157 crores is expected, excluding the potential INR 35 crores from Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: And with this, for 2029, we expect additional business of INR 157 crores, excluding potential business of INR 35 crores of Europe that we estimate it will take little more time, but 100% we are going to convert that.

demand_outlook.claim: For the Alkop segment, around 54 parts have been developed in the last two years, contributing to growth from high value addition products.
demand_outlook.quote: For Menon Alkop, we have developed around 54 parts in the last two years, and they all SOB has begun. So that's why you can see the growth. So a lot of new high value addition products have been added to the portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

capex_expansion.claim: Over the next 12 to 15 months, planned investments are approximately INR 5 crores in Menon Alkop and INR 4 crores in Menon Bearings.
capex_expansion.quote: So what figures we have told you, what we are going to achieve. So this is the investment we are doing to increase productivity and to get these numbers. So this is the investment we are getting, and roughly ROI will be in the next 2.5, 3 years, should be the return on investment on this investment what we are doing.

capex_expansion.claim: Brake division had Rs. 0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with Rs. 2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

capex_expansion.claim: In Alkop alone, the company is having a CapEx of around INR4 crores for the year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: The dynamometer for the brake segment is under construction and expected to be commissioned by the end of August.
capex_expansion.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

margins_costs.claim: Aluminium prices and vendor pricing have decreased to some extent, bringing benefits to the Alkop segment.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, obviously, the rates of aluminium, basically that is the raw material and various aluminium alloys we are applying as a raw material, the prices are down to some extent, and the benefit of which will accrue to the Alkop.

margins_costs.claim: Process improvements and reduced raw material consumption have helped sustain historical margins despite rising prices in copper, tin, lead, and steel.
margins_costs.quote: In spite of volatility in the raw material prices, and basically in copper, tin, lead and steel, the prices have gone up substantially. In spite of that whatever the exercises that we have made, improvement in the processes, so we have reduced substantially so far as the consumption of all these raw material and input material is concerned.

margins_costs.claim: Productivity has increased by 25% over the last period, which helped reduce overhead costs.
margins_costs.quote: Apart from that, you can see there is a volume growth and productivity has substantially increased, that is by 25% over last period. That has really helped us in reducing the overheads overall.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin in brakes has reached 25% due to product mix and operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated margins are expected to be sustained around 20% to 21% over a period of time.
margins_costs.quote: But overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

margins_costs.claim: Carbide tool prices for all automobile manufacturers have increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

orders_capacity.claim: There are nearly 16 bimetal bearing production lines being converted to single-piece flow to save employee count.
orders_capacity.quote: There are almost 16 such lines on which we are getting production of various bearings. So these were all semi-automatic machines which are to the tune of almost 90 in numbers. And all those lines we are making it on a single-piece flow, so that for every line we will be saving almost three people, three employees.

orders_capacity.claim: Peak revenue from the bi-metal division can be above INR400 crores without land expansion.
orders_capacity.quote: Peak revenue from this, it can be aboveINR400 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Over the past six months, the company has not availed any term loans, financing its CapEx out of internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, basically what we have done in the past for more than six months, we have not availed any term loan. Whatever CapEx that we are doing, that is out of internal accruals, which are definitely having the impact on the cash accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: Planned CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded through internal accruals only without taking fresh loans.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

risks_headwinds.claim: Freight shipment times have been at all-time highs and some volatility exists.
risks_headwinds.quote: And being this quarter, like, raw material prices have been all-time high, shipment times have been all-time high. So a lot of volatility.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that automation and visual systems will be fully in place in the next 9 to 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: So in the next 9 to 12 months, a lot of automation and visual systems are getting in place where we save on manpower, we save on time that leads in productivity, and quality is more focused.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets crossing INR 500 crores in revenue next year or the year after that.
management_commitments.quote: So we are taking a lot of efforts so we can reach INR500 crore next year. Most likely next year or maybe year after that.

management_commitments.claim: Five robotic automation initiatives are rolling out between November 2026 and April 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Five initiatives rolling out Nov 2026 – Apr 2027 to lift productivity, quality and machine utilization

management_commitments.claim: Installation of the dual-CNC robotic cell (AMS) for Honeywell STT caps is underway for November 2026.
Design for dual-VMC robotic cell (Brother) for JD ISG parts is complete with execution in progress for January 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Design complete; execution in progress Jan 2027

management_commitments.claim: Simulation and design for dual-VMC robotic cell (AMS) for Honeywell STT housings is underway for March 2027.
Design exploration with supplier for vision inspection and powder coating automation is set for April 2027.
Management expects that railway brake lining business will start with around INR5 crores to INR6 crores in the first year and eventually go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within two years.
management_commitments.quote: we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims for the share of EV in Alkop to be in the range of 8% to 10% by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: share of EV by FY27 end can be in the range of 8% to 10%.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an internal goal of reaching INR500 crore revenue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: We were supposed to reach INR500 crore in 2030, but we are trying to do it as soon as possible. So, in the next 2-3 years, it's our internal target, but let's see.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
